description: Problem: Your tall boots flop over and clutter up your closet. Solved! Tall boots tend to flop over when there are no feet in them, spoiling the shape and taking up valuable space in your closet. No more! Our handy Boot Stand supports four pairs of your favorite boots so they stay neatly upright, preserving their shape and keeping your closet neat. Sturdy metal frame has two levels so it’s ideal for both taller and shorter boots. Easy assembly. Size: 9"L x 29.5"W x 14.88"H.
